_comment: Pre-registered 2026-10-17 before any playtest. Do not edit after the first tester joins; record any change and reason in roblox/ACCEPTANCE.md. All thresholds are judgment calls unless marked official; sources in docs/design-spec.json (playtest_metrics).
state_cohort_source: RFY, ads, or friends/family - report separately; friends/family never count toward pass/fail

d1.basis: GameAnalytics 2025 median ~10%, P90 ~15% for 13-18 min sessions (secondary, undefined denominator)

decision.continue_to_content_and_kids_select_path: bounce, first_flip, one_more_house, session_minutes.pass, d1.pass all met on a >=300 RFY or ads cohort
decision.iterate: any gate missed but no stop condition
decision.stop_roblox_track: session_minutes below stop OR d1 below stop on two consecutive >=300 cohorts after one iteration
